items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: This other fine show on the Burlesque Wheel with Jasper Taylor was playing drums. Jasper Taylor was in Joe Jordan's band.

ctx.x: Yes, that's what he wanted to do.
We saw more than that. This other fine show on the Burlesque Wheel with Jasper Taylor was playing drums. Jasper Taylor was in Joe

Jordan's band. And they played 'Sweet Georgia Brown' for a cat to dance by the name of Lovie Taylor. Boy and did that cat dance. And that music was so perfect behind this cat's taps. He was a tap dancer but it was soft shoe. He didn't have no taps on his shoes.
